name: Anchor Nav
description: A scroll-spy nav of page section anchors that highlights the section in view and smooth-scrolls on click.
usage:
<AnchorNav
  items={[
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { id: 'features', label: 'Features' },
    { id: 'pricing', label: 'Pricing' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: Landmark labelled "On this page" by default.
Anchor links to page sections; the section in view sets aria-current="location".

dos: Give each section a stable id that matches its item.
Seed defaultActiveId when deep links should start highlighted.
donts: Don't use it to display heading hierarchy; use Table of Contents.
Don't render sections inside the nav; it only points at them.

examples.title: Scroll-spy sections
examples.description: An IntersectionObserver tracks the rendered sections and moves the highlight as the page scrolls.

examples.title: Seeded active item
examples.description: defaultActiveId controls the initial highlight before any scrolling happens, useful for deep links.

guidance.useWhen: A long page is split into id-addressable sections and readers need a persistent way to jump between them, such as docs or marketing pages.
guidance.avoidWhen: The links are headings with a hierarchy to display; use TableOfContents to show nesting by heading level.
guidance.behavior: Clicking an item activates it and smooth-scrolls its section into view; scrolling the page updates the active item through IntersectionObserver, and activeId can be controlled.
guidance.responsive: The vertical layout suits side rails on wide screens; on narrow screens hide it or move it above the content.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the section links.
Smooth-scrolls the linked section into view and marks the item active.

notes: Renders a navigation landmark labelled "On this page" by default.
The active item exposes aria-current="location" so the position in the page is announced.
Without IntersectionObserver the links still navigate; only the scroll tracking is skipped.

props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Controlled id of the active section.
props.name: activeId

props.description: Initially active section id when uncontrolled.
props.name: defaultActiveId

props.description: Sections the nav links to and spies on, in document order.
props.name: items

props.description: Called with the section id when the active section changes.
